copy.tagline: 把 Slack 频道接入你的应用
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你开发的应用需要 Slack 聊天功能
copy.tagline_en: Integrate Slack channels into your app
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need Slack chat in your app

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 会把 Slack 适配器、注册测试和格式技能从 channels 分支复制进来,注册适配器、安装 @chat-adapter/slack,引导你创建 Slack 应用并把 xoxb-/xapp- 等凭据写进 .env,重启服务后即可在 Slack 频道和私信里收发消息。
howto.when: 当你要求给 NanoClaw 接入 Slack 频道(运行 add-slack 技能)时接管;如果你正处在 /setup 流程中,完成后会返回该流程。

say.text: 帮我把 Slack 频道接入 NanoClaw
say.note: 会复制适配器、装依赖并引导你创建 Slack 应用

say.text: 用 Socket Mode 接 Slack,不要公网地址
我的 Slack 回复发不出去,帮我查一下
say.note: 会检查事件订阅、App Home 消息标签页等

howto.what_en: Adds Slack to NanoClaw: copies the adapter, registration test and formatting skill from the channels branch, registers it, installs @chat-adapter/slack, collects bot and app tokens into .env, then restarts the service.
howto.when_en: Takes over when you ask to add a Slack channel to NanoClaw (the add-slack skill); if you are inside /setup, return to that flow afterwards.

say_en.note: Copies the adapter, installs the package, walks you through the Slack app

say_en.text: Connect Slack with Socket Mode, no public URL
say_en.note: Socket Mode is used automatically when SLACK_APP_TOKEN is set

say_en.text: My Slack replies never arrive, help me debug
say_en.note: Checks event subscriptions, App Home Messages Tab, restart
